observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a retail box for a Silver Crest blender.
The box identifies the model as SC-9009.
Text on the box claims 4.0L capacity, 9000W power, and 8 blades.
The box shows a red motor base, a large blender jar, and a smaller grinder jar.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on the image.
No photos of the actual physical item outside the box are provided.
